evals.prompt: Use the daily-standup skill. Generate today's standup dashboard for TaskFlow Sprint 12. It's day 3 of 5. Show sprint-level burn, per-person status, and flag anything at risk. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Team-level dashboard: points done/total, items by state, WIP status, pace vs needed pace. Per-person section with DONE/DOING/NEXT/BLOCKED. Attention section listing stalled, blocked, and not-started items.
expectations: The answer says to fetch the active cycle via cycle(action=list, status=current) and resolves day X of Y from its dates
The answer says to group items by assignee AND separately by state group (workitem(action=count, pql='cycle = "<id>"', group_by=state__group) gives the state-group totals in one call)
The answer computes WIP and compares to a limit
The answer computes pace (points/day) and what's needed to finish
The answer has an explicit [!] Attention section flagging at-risk items
The answer renders the dashboard format from the skill, not free-form prose

evals.prompt: Use the daily-standup skill. Give me a per-person standup breakdown for the Billing team's active sprint. Show each member's DONE, DOING, NEXT, and BLOCKED. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: For each team member, a labeled list of items with state, points, and any blocker notes.
expectations: The answer says to fetch project members with member(action=list_project) and cycle work items with cycle(action=list_workitems)
The answer says to group items by assignee
The answer uses the [DONE]/[DOING]/[NEXT]/[BLOCKED] labels from the skill format

The answer flags items in 'In Progress' without activity for >2 days as stalled, e.g. with pql='stateGroup = "started" AND updatedAt < daysAgo(2)', and confirms with workitem_activity before calling one stalled

evals.prompt: Use the daily-standup skill. MP-47 'OAuth setup' has been in progress for 3 days with no activity and is blocked by MP-45 which is still unstarted. Surface this as a standup issue. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Identifies MP-47 as both stalled AND blocked; names the blocker, the owner, and suggests action.
expectations: The answer detects the stalled signal (>2 days no activity)
The answer detects the blocked_by relation to MP-45
The answer says to escalate because the blocker itself is unstarted — double risk
The answer suggests a concrete action (DM the owner, unblock MP-45, or reassign)

evals.prompt: Use the daily-standup skill. We're an async remote team across 5 timezones. How should we run standup and where do we publish the update? In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
